hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.mjs|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.json|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.css|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.astro) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/apps/website" && ./node_modules/.bin/biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true
